## Buildings

Heating, cooling, and constructing buildings without fossil fuels: heat pumps in every form factor, envelope and windows, smart controls, low-carbon materials, and the refrigerant transition. Most of this technology is mature — the constraint is delivery, financing, and demand, which is exactly where the newest companies cluster.

*9 solution areas · 96 variations · 613 company entries (524 unique companies; 14 marked dead, 32 acquired, 11 unverified)*

**Maturity at a glance (variations per stage):** Air-Source Heat Pumps & Electrified HVAC (3 mature, 4 scaling, 2 demonstration, 1 pilot) · Geothermal, Thermal Networks & District Energy (4 mature, 8 scaling, 1 demonstration) · Water Heating & Appliance Electrification (6 mature, 5 scaling, 1 demonstration) · Building Envelope: Insulation, Air Sealing & ... (8 mature, 3 scaling, 2 demonstration) · Windows, Glazing & Solar Control (5 mature, 1 scaling, 2 demonstration, 2 pilot) · Retrofit Delivery, Electrification Platforms ... (1 mature, 7 scaling, 2 demonstration) · Smart Controls, Demand Flexibility & Thermal ... (3 mature, 8 scaling) · Low-Carbon Structural Materials & Industriali... (6 scaling, 4 demonstration) · Refrigerants & Commercial Refrigeration (2 mature, 4 scaling, 1 demonstration)

**Solution areas:** [Air-Source Heat Pumps & Electrified HVAC](#air-source-heat-pumps-electrified-hvac) · [Geothermal, Thermal Networks & District Energy](#geothermal-thermal-networks-district-energy) · [Water Heating & Appliance Electrification](#water-heating-appliance-electrification) · [Building Envelope: Insulation, Air Sealing & Roofs](#building-envelope-insulation-air-sealing-roofs) · [Windows, Glazing & Solar Control](#windows-glazing-solar-control) · [Retrofit Delivery, Electrification Platforms & Financing (Buildings)](#retrofit-delivery-electrification-platforms-financing-buildings) · [Smart Controls, Demand Flexibility & Thermal Storage (Buildings)](#smart-controls-demand-flexibility-thermal-storage-buildings) · [Low-Carbon Structural Materials & Industrialized Construction](#low-carbon-structural-materials-industrialized-construction) · [Refrigerants & Commercial Refrigeration](#refrigerants-commercial-refrigeration)

### Air-Source Heat Pumps & Electrified HVAC

**Central ducted & mini-split air-source heat pumps (incl. hybrid/dual-fuel)** · `🟢 mature`

Inverter-driven vapor-compression units that move heat between outdoor air and the home through ducts or wall-mounted heads, replacing a gas furnace plus AC with one electric appliance — the single biggest lever for residential building decarbonization.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Daikin](https://www.daikin.com/) | incumbent | World's largest HVAC maker (incl. Goodman/Amana in the US); compact ducted 'Fit' inverter systems and the global champion of R32, with royalty-free patent pledges | ~$30B+ annual HVAC revenue; heat pumps designated core growth business |
| [Mitsubishi Electric](https://www.mitsubishicomfort.com/) | incumbent | Mini-split pioneer; Hyper-Heat (H2i) lines and the intelli-HEAT dual-fuel A-coil that converts existing gas furnaces into hybrid heat-pump systems; US JV with Trane (METUS) | De-facto standard ductless brand in the US Northeast |
| [Carrier](https://www.corporate.carrier.com/) | incumbent | Infinity variable-speed ducted heat pumps; bet the portfolio on home electrification by buying Viessmann Climate Solutions for ~€12B (closed Jan 2024) | ~$22B revenue; Viessmann deal was the largest-ever heat pump acquisition |
| [Trane Technologies](https://www.tranetechnologies.com/) | incumbent | XV-series variable-speed residential heat pumps plus the largest commercial electrification install base in North America | ~$20B revenue, climate pure-play since 2020 spinoff |
| [Lennox](https://www.lennox.com/) | incumbent | SL25XPV flagship (first DOE Cold Climate Heat Pump Challenge unit to market) and a 2024 North America JV with Samsung for ductless/mini-split | NYSE: LII, ~$5B revenue |
| [Bosch Home Comfort](https://www.johnsoncontrols.com/media-center/news/press-releases/2025/08/01/johnson-controls-completes-sale-of-residential-and-light-commercial-hvac-business) | incumbent | IDS inverter ducted heat pumps; vaulted into the global top tier by buying Johnson Controls' residential/light-commercial HVAC plus the JCI-Hitachi JV (York, Coleman, Hitachi brands) | $8B acquisition closed Jul 31, 2025 — Bosch's largest ever; 33 plants post-deal |
| [Midea](https://www.mideacomfort.us/) | incumbent | World's largest AC and compressor manufacturer; launched the EVOX G³ cold-climate ducted heat pump platform for North America and OEMs for many western brands | ~$50B+ revenue appliance/HVAC group |
| [Gree](https://global.gree.com/) | incumbent | One of the two largest air conditioner and heat pump manufacturers on earth by volume; major OEM behind western-branded mini-splits | Tens of millions of units/year from Zhuhai-based plants |
| [Quilt](https://techcrunch.com/2025/12/08/heat-pump-startup-quilt-raises-20m-series-b-to-expand-sales/) | startup | Vertically integrated 'Nest-style' mini-split system — flush wall heads, room-level smart controls, in-house design and managed installation | $20M Series B Dec 2025 (Energy Impact Partners + Galvanize; $64M total); ~1,000 units across 16 US states and 5 Canadian provinces |

**Air-to-water hydronic heat pumps** · `🟢 mature`

Heat pumps that produce hot (and chilled) water for radiators, underfloor loops, and fan coils, letting the world's boiler-heated housing stock electrify without ripping out emitters — the dominant heat pump form factor in Europe.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Vaillant](https://www.vaillant-group.com/) | incumbent | aroTHERM plus R290 monobloc (75°C flow) is Europe's benchmark air-to-water unit; dedicated heat pump megafactory in Senica, Slovakia | Among top-3 European heat pump producers by volume |
| [Viessmann Climate Solutions](https://www.viessmann-climatesolutions.com/) | incumbent | Vitocal 250/252 R290 air-to-water family; the German champion sold to Carrier in the sector's landmark consolidation | Acquired by Carrier for ~€12B (closed Jan 2024); continues operating as Carrier's European heat pump arm · **acquired** |
| [NIBE Industrier](https://www.nibe.eu/) | incumbent | Nordic heat pump group; S2125 R290 air-to-water line; bellwether for the European market's 2023-24 slump and subsequent recovery | Stockholm-listed; cut ~500 jobs in 2024 downturn, demand recovering since |
| [Daikin Europe](https://www.daikin.eu/) | incumbent | Altherma air-to-water family; European heat pump market leader with dedicated EU factories (Belgium, Czechia, Poland) | Multi-billion-euro EU heat pump investment program |
| [Stiebel Eltron](https://www.stiebel-eltron.com/) | incumbent | German specialist in air-to-water heat pumps and integrated ventilation/heat-pump systems for low-energy homes | Family-owned, >€1B revenue, heat-pump-led growth |
| [Aira](https://www.pv-magazine.com/2025/08/11/swedish-heat-pump-maker-aira-raises-e150-million-plans-production-capacity-expansion/) | scaleup | Direct-to-consumer brand selling its own R290 air-to-water unit (built in Wrocław, Poland) with in-house installer academies and a monthly subscription model | €150M equity Aug 2025 (Altor, Kinnevik, Temasek et al.); €200M sales run-rate, 1,200 employees across UK/Germany/Italy |
| [Octopus Energy](https://octopus.energy/) | scaleup | UK energy retailer that designed and manufactures its own Cosy 6 R290 heat pump, bundling installs with smart time-of-use tariffs | One of the UK's fastest-growing heat pump installers; Octopus group valued ~$9B |
| [Harvest Thermal](https://www.harvest-thermal.com/news) | startup | US system pairing a CO2 (SANCO2) heat pump water heater with a thermal-storage tank and 'Pod' controller to run home space + water heating on cheap off-peak power | TIME America's Top GreenTech list 2024 and 2025; opened its controls platform ('Harvest Open') to third-party heat pumps mid-2025 |

> **White space:** Air-to-water is mature in Europe but nearly absent from US distribution despite millions of US hydronic and steam-heated homes — an opening for UL-listed high-temp monoblocs and storage-integrated hydronic packages.

**Cold-climate heat pumps** · `🟡 scaling`

Units with vapor-injection compressors, enhanced-capacity refrigerant circuits, and smarter defrost that hold rated heating output at -15°C to -30°C, killing the 'heat pumps don't work in winter' objection in northern markets.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Mitsubishi Electric (METUS)](https://www.mitsubishicomfort.com/) | incumbent | Hyper-Heat H2i delivers 100% heating capacity at 5°F and operates to about -13°F; the reference product for US cold-climate installs | Decades of cold-climate field data; dominant in New England/Canada retrofits |
| [Lennox](https://www.energy.gov/eere/buildings/doe-cold-climate-heat-pump-technology-challenge) | incumbent | SL25XPV — the first DOE Cold Climate Heat Pump Challenge prototype to reach commercial sale (2023) | DOE CCHP Challenge graduate, commercialized ahead of all eight participating OEMs |
| [Trane](https://www.energy.gov/eere/buildings/doe-cold-climate-heat-pump-technology-challenge) | incumbent | DOE CCHP Challenge partner field-testing and commercializing cold-climate ducted units with utility partners | CCHP Challenge prototypes validated in northern-state field trials |
| [Midea](https://www.mideacomfort.us/) | incumbent | EVOX G³ ducted cold-climate system rated to operate down to roughly -22°F at mass-market prices | DOE CCHP Challenge participant; leverages world's largest compressor supply chain |
| [Bosch Home Comfort](https://www.bosch-homecomfort.com/us/en/residential/) | incumbent | IDS Ultra cold-climate ducted heat pump heating to -13°F without resistance backup | Launched 2024 as Bosch's North America cold-climate flagship |
| [Fujitsu General](https://www.fujitsugeneral.com/) | incumbent | Airstage extra-low-temperature mini-splits long used in Nordic and Hokkaido markets | Decades of sub-zero ductless deployments |

**Window, room & portable packaged heat pumps (120V saddle units)** · `🟠 demonstration`

Self-contained plug-in heat pumps that hang over a window sill or slot through a wall on a standard 120V outlet, letting renters and aging multifamily buildings electrify apartment-by-apartment with no ductwork, refrigerant work, or panel upgrades.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Gradient](https://nysfocus.com/2025/04/15/trump-china-tariffs-clean-energy-nycha-heat-pumps) | startup | Purpose-built saddle-style 120V cold-climate window heat pump that preserves window light/egress; co-winner of NYCHA's Clean Heat for All Challenge with a 10,000-unit contract | NYSERDA-backed; NYCHA large-scale deployment slowed during evaluation and 2025 China-tariff pressure, though the 10,000-unit contract remains in effect |
| [Midea](https://www.thecity.nyc/2025/02/27/nycha-electric-heat-pumps-housing-energy-queens/) | incumbent | Packaged Window Heat Pump: 120V saddle unit delivering 100% heating at 5°F; anchor supplier for NYCHA's 20,000-unit Clean Heat for All contract | First full-building NYCHA retrofit (Woodside Houses, Queens) completed 2025; 5,000 more purchased; consumer sales launched at ~$2,800-3,000/unit |
| [Friedrich](https://www.friedrich.com/) | incumbent | Legacy US room-AC maker selling reverse-cycle window and through-wall heat pump units into the multifamily replacement channel | Century-old brand with national distribution |
| [LG Electronics](https://lghvac.com/) | incumbent | Inverter PTAC/through-wall and room heat pump units for apartments and hospitality | Global top-5 room AC manufacturer |
| [Ephoca](https://ephoca.com/) | scaleup | Italian all-in-one through-wall packaged heat pumps (AIO) with no outdoor unit, distributed in North America for room-by-room electrification | Niche but growing US distribution via passive-house channels |

> **White space:** Only one venture pure-play (Gradient) exists and its flagship NYCHA rollout has already slowed while Midea's manufacturing scale sets a ~$3k price floor; the opening is a sub-$2,000 saddle unit, tariff-proof domestic assembly, and a landlord/MDU sales channel — the prize is millions of US steam-heated apartments.

**Commercial rooftop unit (RTU) heat pumps & VRF/VRV systems** · `🟡 scaling`

Packaged rooftop heat pumps and variable-refrigerant-flow systems that electrify the gas-heated boxes conditioning roughly half of US commercial floor area and provide zoned heat recovery in large buildings.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [AAON](https://www.aaon.com/) | incumbent | Premium configurable RTUs with heat-pump and efficiency options far above code minimums; semi-custom approach makes it the electrification leader in packaged rooftops | NASDAQ: AAON, ~$1.2B revenue and growing data-center cooling arm (BASX) |
| [Daikin Applied](https://www.daikinapplied.com/) | incumbent | Invented VRV/VRF in 1982 and sells the Rebel/Rebel Applied high-efficiency heat pump RTU lines in North America | Global VRF market leader |
| [Trane](https://www.achrnews.com/articles/155050-advances-in-heat-pump-rooftop-units-for-cold-climates) | incumbent | Voyager/Precedent heat-pump RTUs; DOE Commercial Building Heat Pump Accelerator participant developing cold-climate HP RTUs with Symbio controls | DOE accelerator prototypes entered national-lab validation by June 2025, targeting commercial units by Dec 2027 |
| [Carrier](https://www.achrnews.com/articles/155050-advances-in-heat-pump-rooftop-units-for-cold-climates) | incumbent | WeatherExpert high-efficiency heat pump RTUs and a DOE accelerator participant for cold-climate rooftop heat pumps | Largest US RTU installed base alongside Trane/Lennox |
| [LG Electronics](https://lghvac.com/) | incumbent | Multi V VRF platform pushing all-electric heat-recovery systems for mid/high-rise commercial buildings | Top-3 global VRF vendor |
| [Samsung HVAC](https://www.lennoxinternational.com/) | incumbent | DVM S2 VRF systems; formed a 2024 North America joint venture with Lennox to scale ductless and VRF distribution | Samsung-Lennox JV operational since 2024 |

> **White space:** Essentially zero startups: AHRI certification, dealer networks, and rooftop curb standards are incumbent moats — the opening is drop-in, curb-compatible cold-climate heat pump RTUs and gas-RTU retrofit kits, which is exactly what DOE's accelerator is trying to pull from incumbents by 2027.

**High-temperature heat pumps for boiler & steam-system replacement** · `🟡 scaling`

Air-source units producing 70-90°C water so radiator- and steam-heated buildings can drop gas boilers without replacing emitters or repiping — the key to electrifying pre-war urban housing stock.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Daikin](https://www.daikin.eu/) | incumbent | Altherma 3 H HT delivers 70°C flow at -15°C ambient, marketed explicitly as a drop-in boiler replacement for existing radiators | Sold at volume across European boiler-swap programs |
| [OCHSNER](https://www.ochsner.com/) | incumbent | Austrian high-temperature specialist; AIR HAWK and commercial series reach ~75°C+ for legacy hydronic buildings | Four decades of high-temp heat pump engineering |
| [Lambda Wärmepumpen](https://lambda-wp.at/) | scaleup | Austrian R290 units with patented eZeta injection cycle posting some of Europe's highest measured SCOPs at 65-70°C flow for radiator homes | Top of independent efficiency rankings (e.g. HTW Berlin tests); expanding DACH production |
| [Mitsubishi Electric](https://www.mitsubishicomfort.com/) | incumbent | QAHV CO2 (R744) heat pump producing 90°C water, used to replace gas boilers in commercial and multifamily hot-water/hydronic loops | Deployed in US/UK commercial electrification projects |
| [Kelvin (formerly Radiator Labs)](https://www.kel.vin/) | startup | Brooklyn startup electrifying NYC steam buildings incrementally — Cozy smart radiator covers plus heat pumps and thermal storage ('hybrid electrification') claiming 60-80% of space heat electrified at ~20% of full-retrofit cost | $30M Series A (2022); NYSERDA-validated 25.5% average heating savings; hybrid system targeted commercial readiness ~2025 |

> **White space:** US steam and pre-war hydronic multifamily has almost no UL-listed high-temperature ASHP options — Europe's 70-75°C R290 monoblocs haven't crossed the Atlantic — leaving Kelvin nearly alone against tens of thousands of NYC-style steam buildings facing Local Law 97-type emissions fines.

**Natural & low-GWP refrigerant heat pumps (R290, CO2, R32/R454B)** · `🟡 scaling`

Heat pumps charged with propane (GWP ~3), CO2, or lower-GWP HFO blends to eliminate the refrigerant half of HVAC's climate impact as the EU F-gas regulation and US AIM Act squeeze HFCs out.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Vaillant](https://www.vaillant-group.com/) | incumbent | Bet its flagship aroTHERM plus line on R290 propane, proving natural refrigerants can lead the mass market while enabling 75°C flow temperatures | R290 monoblocs now the best-selling architecture in several EU markets |
| [NIBE](https://www.nibe.eu/) | incumbent | S2125 and successors moved NIBE's core air-to-water range to R290 ahead of F-gas deadlines | R290 across new Nordic product generations |
| [Wolf](https://www.wolf.eu/) | incumbent | German maker whose CHA-Monoblock was an early mainstream R290 air-to-water unit | R290 monobloc shipping at volume since 2020 |
| [Carrier](https://www.corporate.carrier.com/) | incumbent | Led the US residential transition to R454B ('Puron Advance') across heat pump and AC lines under the AIM Act's 2025 changeover | 2025 industry-wide R454B transition (with a telling refrigerant-cylinder shortage) completed across US majors |
| [Octopus Energy](https://octopus.energy/) | scaleup | Cosy 6 designed in-house around R290 from day one, paired with installer training to handle A3 flammable-refrigerant rules | Thousands of UK installs under government BUS grants |
| [Midea](https://www.mideacomfort.us/) | incumbent | Ships R290 monobloc air-to-water units into Europe and supplies R290-ready compressors at the largest scale of any manufacturer | World's largest compressor maker tooling for natural refrigerants |

> **White space:** US codes and UL listings still largely block A3 (flammable) refrigerants indoors, so R290 — Europe's winning answer — has no US residential foothold; first movers on US-listed R290 packaged/monobloc designs (charge kept outdoors or hermetically small, e.g. window units) get a multi-year head start when rules loosen.

**Thermally driven & gas-absorption heat pumps** · `🟢 mature`

Heat pumps driven by gas combustion or engine shaft power (ammonia-water absorption, gas-engine vapor compression) that deliver 130-160% of fuel heating value — a transitional niche for buildings whose grids, panels, or budgets can't yet support full electrification.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Stone Mountain Technologies (SMTI)](https://www.lpgasmagazine.com/stone-mountain-technologies-increases-production-of-gas-heat-pumps/) | startup | Anesi ammonia-absorption gas heat pump (~140% AFUE, propane or natural gas) for homes and light commercial — the main new North American entrant | Commercially available since Feb 2024; expanding rep network 2025 (A to Z Sales midwest, BSAL Atlantic Canada); championed by the propane industry |
| [Robur](https://www.robur.com/) | incumbent | Italian manufacturer selling commercial gas-absorption heat pumps (GAHP) for decades, the established European supplier in the niche | Long-running commercial product line |
| [Yanmar Energy System](https://www.yanmar.com/) | incumbent | Gas-engine heat pumps (GHP) widely deployed in Japanese commercial buildings to shave peak electric demand | Hundreds of thousands of GHP units installed in Japan |
| [Aisin (Toyota Group)](https://www.aisin.com/) | incumbent | Major manufacturer of gas-engine heat pump systems alongside Yanmar in the Japanese GHP duopoly | Decades-old commercial GHP line |
| [Tecogen](https://www.tecogen.com/) | incumbent | US maker of natural-gas engine-driven chillers/heat pumps and CHP for buildings with constrained electric service | NYSE American: TGEN; niche but persistent installed base |

> **White space:** Sparse by design: at COP ~1.4 on fossil fuel versus 3-4 electric, the niche shrinks as grids decarbonize — it remains credible only where gas/propane infrastructure is sunk and electric capacity is scarce (rural propane markets, demand-constrained urban feeders), so few entrants is rational rather than an opportunity gap.

**Solid-state & caloric heating/cooling (thermoelectric, elastocaloric, magnetocaloric, barocaloric, thermoacoustic)** · `🔵 pilot`

Replaces the vapor-compression cycle with solid refrigerants or acoustic/semiconductor effects — zero F-gases, no compressor wear, and theoretically higher efficiency — but power density and cost still trail compressors, so F-gas regulation is the commercial wedge.

> **White space:** Crowded with startups but empty of shipped space-conditioning products — specific cooling power, cyclic fatigue, and cost per kW all still lose to a $300 rotary compressor; the realistic wedge is F-gas phase-down niches (refrigeration, dehumidification) before whole-building HVAC.

**Ultra-efficient AC & dehumidification (desiccant/evaporative hybrids) + high-efficiency HVAC components** · `🟠 demonstration`

Splits humidity removal from sensible cooling using liquid or solid desiccants and advanced evaporative stages — cutting AC electricity 30-90% and shaving peak demand — while next-gen motors and oil-free compressors squeeze the remaining watts out of conventional systems; cooling is the fastest-growing electricity end use on earth.

### Geothermal, Thermal Networks & District Energy

**Single-building ground-source heat pump equipment** · `🟢 mature`

Closed- or open-loop borefields paired with electric heat pumps deliver 300-500%-efficient heating and cooling from stable ground temperatures for individual homes and buildings — the workhorse hardware of building geothermal.

| [ClimateMaster](https://www.marketresearchfuture.com/reports/ground-source-heat-pump-market-30712) | incumbent | Oklahoma-based maker of water-source/geothermal heat pumps (Tranquility/TT series) for residential and commercial buildings, part of NIBE's Climate Control Group. | TT series regarded as top-tier on price/efficiency; long-integrated into NIBE's North American geothermal portfolio. |
| [NIBE Industrier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nibe_Industrier) | incumbent | Swedish heating group that is Europe's largest ground-source heat pump maker and the sector's consolidator (owns WaterFurnace, ClimateMaster/Climate Control Group, CTC and others). | Built the #1 European and North American geothermal positions via serial acquisitions; recovering from the 2023-24 European heat pump destocking slump. |
| [Bosch Home Comfort](https://www.fortunebusinessinsights.com/industry-reports/geothermal-heat-pump-market-100747) | incumbent | Supplies geothermal and water-source heat pumps (Florida Heat Pump lineage) and is expanding US heat pump manufacturing capacity. | Among the top global GSHP players; investing in US production as IRA tax credits lift demand. |
| [Viessmann Climate Solutions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viessmann) | incumbent | German maker of ground-source and air-source heat pumps for European homes and light commercial buildings. | Acquired by Carrier Global for ~€12B (closed January 2024); continues operating as Carrier's European heat pump arm. · **acquired** |

**Residential geothermal developers & drilling cost reduction** · `🟡 scaling`

Vertically integrated installers attack the biggest residential geothermal cost — drilling — with purpose-built rigs, software and homebuilder partnerships to make home ground-source systems price-competitive with gas furnaces and air-source heat pumps.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Dandelion Energy](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/dandelion-energy-and-lennar-announce-one-of-the-largest-residential-geothermal-deployments-in-us-history-302417823.html) | startup | Google X spinout doing vertically integrated home geothermal; pivoted from one-off retrofits to volume new-construction deployments with production homebuilders. | $40M Series C (2024) after $70M round co-led by Lennar's LenX; deploying geothermal in 1,500+ new Lennar homes in Colorado starting 2025 — one of the largest US residential geothermal deployments ever. |

> **White space:** Retrofit drilling economics remain brutal — rig mobilization and per-foot costs dwarf the heat pump itself, which pushed even category leader Dandelion from one-off retrofits to new-build subdivisions where rigs amortize across adjacent lots. Openings: compact low-cost residential rigs and one-day installs, and replicating the Lennar playbook with other production builders in states with stacked geothermal incentives (CO, NY, MA) — almost no other venture-backed residential geothermal developer exists in the US.

**Advanced boreholes & commercial-scale geo-exchange** · `🟡 scaling`

Startups apply oilfield drilling automation, groundwater heat exchange and subsurface digital modeling to cut borehole cost and footprint so offices, campuses, high-rises and data centers can replace chillers and boilers with geo-exchange.

Shared borefields and ambient-temperature street loops connect whole neighborhoods to heat pumps, letting gas utilities redeploy pipe-laying crews and rate-based capital into low-carbon heating — enabled by thermal-energy-network legislation now passed in 10+ US states.

**Data-center & industrial waste-heat reuse into buildings and networks** · `🟡 scaling`

Compute and industrial facilities reject enormous low-grade heat; capturing it via heat exchangers and heat pumps into district networks — or placing compute directly inside pools and buildings — turns a cooling cost into revenue and displaces gas, increasingly mandated by laws like Germany's Energy Efficiency Act.

**Wastewater & sewage heat recovery** · `🟡 scaling`

Sewers carry 10-25°C water year-round; in-pipe or pumped heat exchangers plus heat pumps recover this heat for buildings and district loops — proven physics that remains under-deployed relative to the resource.

> **White space:** Cheap, proven physics but fragmented adoption: every project needs sewer-utility access agreements and custom engineering, and category leader SHARC's ~$3M revenue after a decade shows how slow sales cycles are. The opening is standardized, code-driven products sold through heat-network developers and mandates (Vancouver-style low-carbon energy systems, Scandinavian and German waste-heat rules).

**Seasonal & underground thermal energy storage (ATES, BTES, pit, caverns, heat batteries)** · `🟡 scaling`

Storing summer heat or cheap wind/solar electricity as heat in aquifers, boreholes, water pits, rock caverns or sand silos lets networks shift renewable heat across days to seasons, cutting peak fossil boilers and power-market exposure.

### Water Heating & Appliance Electrification

**Unitary 240V heat pump water heaters** · `🟢 mature`

A heat pump mounted on a storage tank pulls heat from surrounding air into the water at 3-4x the efficiency of resistance or gas units, making it the default drop-in appliance for electrifying the roughly 15-20% of home energy that goes to hot water.

**120V plug-in and low-amperage HPWHs for no-rewire retrofits** · `🟡 scaling`

Low-amperage heat pump water heaters plug into a standard 120V outlet (often sharing an existing circuit), eliminating the panel upgrades and rewiring that block gas-to-electric water heater swaps in older homes and multifamily buildings.

Smith](https://www.greenbuildingadvisor.com/article/a-new-generation-of-heat-pump-water-heaters-is-on-the-way) | incumbent | 120V plug-in HPWH adding a backup heating element and field-convertibility to 240V, addressing slow-recovery objections. | Second-generation 120V entrant with backup element and 240V conversion |

> **White space:** Only the big three incumbents ship 120V units: shared-circuit operation forces small compressors and slow recovery (physics), and UL/SKU economics favor scale manufacturers. Openings: variable-speed low-amperage designs with predictive controls (the gap Cala Systems targets), 120V units bundled with mixing valves and storage intelligence, and multifamily channel plays where panel capacity is the binding constraint.

**Split-system and CO2-refrigerant HPWHs (residential)** · `🟡 scaling`

Splitting the compressor outdoors from the indoor tank and using natural CO2 refrigerant (GWP of 1) delivers 130-175F water even below -15F with no indoor noise or space penalty; the approach is mature in Japan as 'Eco Cute' and scaling in the US and Australia.

| [Corona](https://heatpumpingtechnologies.org/publications/an-inside-story-behind-the-advent-of-eco-cute-co2-heat-pump-water-heater-for-residential-use/) | incumbent | Japanese heating manufacturer that launched the world's first Eco Cute residential CO2 HPWH in 2001. | First mover of a category that has since shipped >10M units in Japan |

> **White space:** Outside Japan only a couple of niche importers (ECO2 Systems, Reclaim) serve split-CO2 demand; $5-7k unit costs and installer unfamiliarity are the barriers. Tightening low-GWP refrigerant rules (A2L transition) create an opening for cost-reduced CO2 splits and for Japanese incumbents to localize Western residential product.

Large air-to-water heat pump plants — often CO2-based to reach 150F+ storage temperatures — centrally produce domestic hot water for apartment blocks, hotels and commercial kitchens, displacing the gas boilers that dominate multifamily water heating.

**Smart and grid-interactive water heaters, connected tanks and intelligent controls** · `🟡 scaling`

Connected tanks and retrofit controllers treat every water heater as a pre-installed thermal battery, shifting heating into cheap, clean hours and selling demand response and even frequency-response services to utilities.

A single heat pump charges a smart thermal-storage tank that serves both space heating/cooling and domestic hot water, cutting equipment count and letting the home buy heat at off-peak prices like a battery.

Opening for packaged, forced-air-compatible combi kits and controls that let one heat pump serve HVAC + DHW with thermal storage as the load-shifting asset.

**Drain-water heat recovery** · `🟢 mature`

A copper heat exchanger wrapped around the shower drain passively preheats incoming cold water with heat that would go down the drain, recovering 30-50% of shower energy with no moving parts; at building scale, wastewater energy transfer does the same for whole districts.

| [EcoDrain](https://ecodrain.com/en/) | startup | Plate-style heat exchangers that keep 30-45% recovery even in horizontal drain runs where vertical falling-film units cannot install. | Niche Quebec manufacturer; differentiated horizontal-install patent position |
| [ThermoDrain](https://www.ecohome.net/en/guides/4193/drain-water-heat-recovery/) | incumbent | Quebec DWHR maker competing on price in Canada's code-driven new-construction market. | One of three brands dominating Canadian DWHR code compliance |
| [SHARC Energy Systems](https://www.sharcenergy.com/) | scaleup | Building- and district-scale wastewater energy transfer (SHARC, Piranha) that filters sewage and extracts heat for DHW and space conditioning. | Public company (CSE: SHRC); installs across North America/UK district and multifamily projects |
| [Recoup Energy Solutions](https://recoupwwhrs.co.uk/) | scaleup | UK leader in vertical shower wastewater heat recovery (WWHRS) specified through SAP in new-build housing. | WWHRS routinely specified in UK volume housebuilding for SAP compliance |
| [Joulia](https://www.joulia.com/) | startup | Swiss maker of heat-recovery shower channels integrated directly into shower trays for new bathrooms. | Integrated into Swiss/European new-build and renovation bathroom supply chains |

> **White space:** The tech is mature, passive and cheap, yet adoption is tiny: retrofits need drain-stack access and save only tens of dollars a year per home, so no venture-scale company has formed. The realistic openings are code mandates (UK SAP, Canadian energy codes), bundling into multifamily central hot-water packages, and building-scale sewage heat recovery where SHARC is nearly alone.

Rooftop thermal collectors — or, increasingly, diverters that dump surplus rooftop-PV electricity into the tank's element — heat water with on-site solar; classic collectors are ceding ground to PV-diversion as PV-plus-heat-pump economics win.

### Building Envelope: Insulation, Air Sealing & Roofs

**Cellulose and recycled-content insulation** · `🟢 mature`

Loose-fill, dense-pack and batt insulation made from recycled paper, cardboard or textiles stores carbon, has very low embodied energy, and is already cost-competitive with fiberglass for attics and retrofit wall fills.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|

**Wood-fiber insulation** · `🟡 scaling`

Batts, rigid boards and loose-fill made from softwood residuals offer fiberglass-class R-values with carbon storage and vapor-open performance, and are moving from a mature European niche into North America.

| [Steico](https://www.kingspangroup.com/en/news-insights/kingspan-announces-acquisition-of-majority-stake-in-steico-se/) | incumbent | World's largest wood-fibre insulation producer (flexible batts, rigid boards, I-joists) with 27 production lines in Poland and France. | Kingspan completed its €251M purchase of a 51% stake in January 2024; demand tied to EU renovation wave. · **acquired** |

| [Soprema (Pavatex)](https://www.soprema.com) | incumbent | French waterproofing/roofing group that produces Pavatex wood-fibre insulation boards within its envelope portfolio. | Pavatex integrated since 2016 with pan-European distribution. |

> **White space:** North America has exactly one producer (TimberHP), and its Chapter 11 shows the capital intensity of mill conversions; as codes start counting embodied carbon, a second NA plant or low-cost import channel is an obvious opening.

**Aerogel and vacuum-insulated panels for space-constrained retrofits** · `🟡 scaling`

Silica aerogels and vacuum panels deliver 2-10x the R-value per inch of conventional insulation, letting thin walls, terraces and historic facades be insulated where thickness is impossible — at a steep price premium.

**Low-GWP spray foams (HFO-blown) and cavity-fill alternatives** · `🟢 mature`

Closed-cell spray polyurethane delivers high R-per-inch plus air sealing, and the switch from HFC to HFO blowing agents (GWP ~1 vs ~700+) removed most of its lifecycle climate penalty.

**Air-sealing technology: aerosolized envelope/duct sealing and membrane/tape systems** · `🟢 mature`

Air leakage drives 25-40% of heating/cooling loads; aerosolized sealants plug leaks from inside ducts and whole envelopes in hours, while tapes, smart membranes and integrated sheathing achieve airtightness in new construction.

| [SIGA](https://www.siga.swiss) | incumbent | Swiss family firm making high-performance airtightness tapes, membranes and adhesives used in passive-house construction. | Staple of EU and North American high-performance building. |
| [Pro Clima (MOLL)](https://proclima.com) | incumbent | INTELLO smart vapor-retarder membranes and complete airtight-system components. | German airtightness pioneer with decades in market. |
| [Huber Engineered Woods](https://www.huberwood.com) | incumbent | ZIP System sheathing integrates the structural panel, water-resistive barrier and taped air barrier in one product, displacing housewrap. | Dominant US new-build air-barrier system; J.M. Huber subsidiary. |
| [3M](https://www.3m.com) | incumbent | Flashing and air-sealing tapes (8067 All Weather) and air-barrier membranes for residential and commercial envelopes. | Diversified materials incumbent. |
| [Henry (Carlisle)](https://www.henry.com) | incumbent | Blueskin self-adhered air/water barrier membranes for commercial and residential walls. | Acquired by Carlisle Companies for $1.575B in 2021. · **acquired** |

> **White space:** Aerosolized interior sealing is effectively a one-company category — Aeroseal holds the LBNL-lineage technology with no scaled competitor; automated or robot-applied sealing for the labor-starved retrofit market is open ground.

Metamaterial films and ultra-white paints reflect ~95-98% of sunlight and radiate heat out through the atmosphere's 8-13µm window, cooling surfaces below ambient with zero electricity — a step beyond conventional cool roofs.

### Windows, Glazing & Solar Control

**Triple-pane and passive-house-grade windows and frames** · `🟢 mature`

Three glass panes plus thermally broken, airtight frames roughly halve window heat loss versus standard double-pane units, removing the weakest element of the building envelope; standard in Europe and now pushed in the US by ENERGY STAR 7.0 and IRA incentives.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Alpen High Performance Products](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/alpen-closes-18-million-capital-raise-302175539.html) | scaleup | Colorado maker of thin-glass triple/quad IGUs and ultra-efficient fiberglass windows that hit passive-house performance at lower weight | $18M raise Jun 2024 anchored by $5.9M DOE grant; factory expansion adding ~100 jobs |
| [Zola Windows](https://zolawindows.com/) | startup | Boutique Colorado supplier of European-made Passive House-certified wood, uPVC and aluminum windows for high-end North American projects | Supplying NA passive-house custom market since 2008 |
| [Intus Windows](https://www.intuswindows.com/) | scaleup | Volume supplier of European-style triple-pane uPVC windows for US multifamily, including Sendero Verde, the world's largest residential Passive House project | One of the largest European-style window suppliers in North America; PHIUS-verified Supera line |
| [Cascadia Windows](https://passivehouseaccelerator.com/articles/cascadia-component-spotlight-recap-versatility-and-value-in-passive-house-windows-systems) | scaleup | BC-based manufacturer of fiberglass triple-glazed windows and the first fiberglass window-wall system for mid-rise construction | Universal Series Window Wall won 2024 Architizer A+ Product Award |
| [Internorm](https://www.internorm.com/) | incumbent | Austria's family-owned window giant where triple glazing is the standard product across the entire range | Europe's leading premium window brand; tens of millions of units produced |
| [Schüco](https://www.schueco.com/) | incumbent | German facade and window systems house supplying high-performance aluminum and uPVC frame systems to fabricators worldwide | Multi-billion-euro revenue; global spec leader for commercial fenestration systems |
| [Andersen Windows](https://www.andersenwindows.com/) | incumbent | Largest North American window maker, now offering triple-pane options across mainstream lines and investing in glazing startups (was an Ubiquitous Energy investor) | ~$3B revenue; triple-pane moving into volume residential with ENERGY STAR 7.0 |

**Vacuum-insulated glazing (VIG)** · `🟡 scaling`

Two panes separated by a sub-millimeter evacuated gap deliver wall-like center-of-glass insulation (R-10 to R-18) in a unit thin and light enough to drop into existing sashes, enabling deep window retrofits without replacing frames.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [LuxWall](https://www.crainsdetroit.com/manufacturing/luxwall-lands-51m-fundraising-round) | scaleup | Michigan startup making Enthermal R-18 VIG and operating the first high-volume US VIG plant | $51M Series B Nov 2024 (Climate Investment, Barclays); Litchfield MI plant opened Aug 2024; second Detroit plant part of $165M, 450-job Michigan buildout; Breakthrough Energy-backed |
| [NSG / Pilkington](https://www.pilkington.com/en/us/products/product-categories/thermal-insulation/pilkington-spacia) | incumbent | Maker of Spacia, the first commercial VIG (Japan, 1997), sold globally for slim heritage retrofits | 25+ years of commercial VIG production |
| [AGC (Fineo)](https://www.fineoglass.eu/product/) | incumbent | Runs a purpose-built Belgian plant making pump-port-free Fineo VIG aimed at monument and heritage window retrofit | Dedicated Brussels-area facility; 20-year warranty product sold across Europe |
| [Vitro Architectural Glass](https://www.vitroglazings.com/about/news/vitro-architectural-glass-reaches-exclusive-long-term-agreement-to-manufacture-vacumax-vacuum-insulating-glass-vig-units-in-north-america/) | incumbent | North America's largest glassmaker, bringing tempered VacuMax VIG production onshore via an exclusive agreement with VIG Technologies/LandVac | Exclusive long-term NA manufacturing and licensing agreement signed Nov 2025 |
| [LandGlass (LandVac)](https://www.gowercroft.co.uk/news/whats-the-best-vacuum-glass-on-the-market/) | incumbent | Leading Chinese producer of fully tempered VIG with the lowest U-values on the market, now licensing technology westward | Lowest U-value among major VIG products per independent comparisons; tech behind Vitro's VacuMax |
| [Panasonic](https://panasonic.net/phs/glavenir/) | incumbent | Adapted plasma-display vacuum tech into Glavenir VIG and now sells complete turnkey VIG manufacturing lines to European and North American glass factories | Triple-pane-beating performance in a 6-8mm unit; pivoted to equipment-line sales model |
| [V-Glass](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260317061588/en/V-Glass-Secures-$3M-Investment-to-Initiate-Move-from-Lab-Scale-Production-into-a-Pilot-Plant) | startup | Wisconsin startup with a hermetic metal-seal VIG design targeting cost parity with conventional IGUs (50-75% below first-gen VIG cost) | $3M seed led by Grantham Foundation plus $1M ARPA-E GLASING award (Mar 2026); moving from lab to pilot plant; NREL-tested panels |

**Electrochromic and other electrically dynamic smart glass** · `🟠 demonstration`

Glazing that tints on demand under a small applied voltage (electrochromic, SPD or liquid-crystal), cutting cooling loads, glare and blind usage while preserving views — commercially proven for a decade but capital-heavy manufacturing bankrupted the first generation of pure-plays in 2024.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [View Inc.](https://www.bisnow.com/national/news/proptech/view-smart-glass-chapter-11-going-private-cantor-fitzgerald-123631) | scaleup | Built the largest dedicated EC fab (Olive Branch, MS) and the highest-profile smart-glass brand for US commercial real estate | Consumed well over $2B (incl. $1.1B SoftBank) and SPAC'd in 2021; Chapter 11 Apr 2024 wiped equity; emerged private May 2024 under lender/Cantor Fitzgerald- and RXR-linked ownership |
| [⚠️ Halio (formerly Kinestral)](https://www.nextenergytech.com/post/lessons-learned-from-smart-glass-1-0) | scaleup | Made fast-switching, color-neutral EC glass with fabs in California and Taiwan | ~$564M raised over 11 rounds, incl. $70M from SKC in late 2023; became insolvent and shut down in H1 2024 · **☠ shut down** |
| [SageGlass (Saint-Gobain)](https://www.sageglass.com/company/sageglass-saint-gobain) | incumbent | The only smart-glass maker owned by a global building-materials group; produces EC glass at its Faribault, MN plant | Wholly owned by Saint-Gobain since 2012; commercial production since 2013; still actively selling worldwide as of 2025-26 |
| [Miru Smart Technologies](https://www.bctechnology.com/news/2026/1/21/Miru-Smart-Technologies-Receives-Investment-From-Specialty-Materials-Leader-Mativ-to-Accelerate-eWindow-Commercialization.cfm) | startup | Vancouver startup making low-cost EC windows on existing glass-coating infrastructure, including the world's largest compound-curved EC sunroof for vehicles | C$27.4M Series A Aug 2024; US$5M venture debt Feb 2025; first commercial purchase orders 2025; strategic equity from Mativ Jan 2026 |
| [Tynt Technologies](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/tynt/__jGH4XbK0TDMTHEEeSDSmXvHSxP-Pz9Gu-xr7A57tGTY) | startup | CU Boulder spinout using reversible metal electrodeposition so windows tint continuously to full blackout, replacing both low-e shading and blinds | ~$16M raised to date; Series A-II ($2.75M) Nov 2025; DOE-supported technology |
| [Glass Dyenamics](https://glassdyenamics.com/) | startup | Early-stage developer pitching lower-cost dynamic glass for residential price points | Small seed-stage venture; little verifiable public activity since ~2023 · *status unverified* |
| [ChromoGenics](https://chromogenics.com/) | scaleup | Swedish maker of ConverLight foil-based dynamic glass laminated by partner glassworks | Delisted from Nasdaq First North Sep 2024 amid ~30% staff cuts; continuing at reduced scale as of late 2025 |
| [Gauzy](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/03/11/3040427/0/en/Gauzy-Ltd-Announces-Record-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2024-Results.html) | scaleup | Israeli maker of SPD and liquid-crystal smart-glass films for architecture and transport (aircraft, automotive) | Nasdaq IPO Jun 2024 raised $75M at ~$244M valuation; FY2024 revenue $103.5M (+33%); guiding $130-140M for 2025 |

> **White space:** The 2024 collapse of View (>$2B consumed) and Halio ($564M) showed that dedicated EC fabs cannot survive construction-industry sales cycles; the opening is low-capex routes — retrofittable EC films, reversible-metal-electrodeposition chemistry, or licensing deposition onto existing float/coating lines — rather than another billion-dollar greenfield fab.

**Thermochromic and passive-dynamic glazing** · `🟠 demonstration`

Interlayers or coatings that darken automatically as direct sunlight heats the glass, providing dynamic solar control with zero wiring, power or controls — a cheap alternative to electrochromics, at the cost of occupant control.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Pleotint (Suntuitive)](https://suntuitiveglass.com/about-pleotint/) | startup | Michigan maker of the Suntuitive sunlight-responsive thermochromic interlayer, once billed as the world's most-adopted dynamic glass | Production and sales of the Suntuitive line suspended since the COVID era; suspension notice still posted in 2025, company says it hopes to return · *status unverified* |
| [RavenWindow (RavenBrick)](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/ravenbrick) | startup | Denver startup that made thermochromic-filter retrofit windows switching at a set temperature | Raised VC and utility-partner funding in the 2010s; website and operations appear defunct since ~2020 · *status unverified* |

> **White space:** Effectively vacant after Pleotint suspended production and RavenWindow folded: passive tint tracks glass temperature rather than occupant intent (tinting on hot overcast days, lagging in winter sun) and offers no smart-building data story to justify premiums. The opening is commodity-priced thermochromic PVB bundled into standard laminating lines for hot-climate volume housing, where 'no controls' is a feature rather than a bug.

**Window inserts, secondary glazing and low-e storm windows** · `🟢 mature`

A second sealed pane added inside or outside existing windows captures most of the energy benefit of full replacement at roughly a quarter of the cost, making it the highest-ROI fenestration retrofit — especially for historic buildings and the huge single-pane commercial stock.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Indow](https://www.windowanddoor.com/news/aerc-certifies-commercial-secondary-window-systems) | scaleup | Portland, OR maker of compression-fit acrylic interior inserts requiring no hardware, certified in standard and acoustic grades | AERC-certified for commercial use; claims ~20% heating/cooling savings and up to 70% noise reduction; widely used in historic preservation |
| [Larson Manufacturing](https://www.larsondoors.com/) | incumbent | Largest US storm-window maker; ComfortSeal low-e interior storm windows sold at big-box price points | Four low-e interior models AERC-certified; acquired by Fortune Brands in 2020 and still the channel leader · **acquired** |
| [Quanta Technologies (QuantaPanel)](https://www.quantapanel.com/) | startup | Pennsylvania maker of architectural low-e interior 'insulating glass systems' (600/700 series) that upgrade commercial and multifamily windows to near-replacement performance | ENERGY STAR and AERC certified; qualifies for federal retrofit tax credits; active through 2025 |
| [Magnetite](https://magnetite.com.au/) | scaleup | Long-running US/Australia franchise retrofitting magnetically attached acrylic secondary glazing over existing frames | Decades of installs across residential and commercial retrofit; active dealer network |
| [Alpen (WinSert)](https://www.thinkalpen.com/blogs/alpen-secures-18-million-in-financing) | scaleup | Sells WinSert thin-glass, low-e insert panels purpose-built for commercial window retrofits without replacement | DOE-backed thin-glass IGU capacity expansion ($18M, 2024) supports insert line |

> **White space:** Residential is well served, but commercial secondary glazing has only small players (Indow, Quanta) facing an enormous single-pane office stock under LL97-style carbon fines — the gap is scale-up capital, installer networks and financing models more than technology.

**Solar-control and low-e retrofit window films** · `🟢 mature`

Thin polymer films with spectrally selective or low-e metal/ceramic coatings applied to existing glass reject a large share of solar heat (and, in low-e versions, retain winter heat) at a small fraction of glazing-replacement cost.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [3M](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/window-film-us/) | incumbent | Inventor of much of the category; Prestige spectrally selective and Thinsulate low-e films that add roughly a pane's worth of performance to existing glass | Global market leader with decades of architectural film deployment |
| [Eastman (LLumar/SunTek/V-Kool)](https://llumar.com/) | incumbent | Owns the world's largest window-film brand portfolio spanning architectural solar-control and safety films | LLumar is the most widely distributed architectural film brand globally |
| [Madico](https://www.madico.com/) | incumbent | Florida-based film maker (owned by Japan's Lintec) producing solar-control, safety and energy films | One of the oldest US film manufacturers, supplying global dealer networks |
| [Saint-Gobain (Solar Gard)](https://www.solargard.com/) | incumbent | Architectural and automotive solar-control films arm of the French materials giant | Sold in 90+ countries with documented carbon-negative product footprint claims |
| [Avery Dennison (Hanita Coatings)](https://hanitacoatings.com/) | incumbent | Israeli coater Hanita, acquired by Avery Dennison in 2017, makes SolarZone exterior-grade solar-control films popular for commercial retrofits | Integrated into Avery Dennison's global films business since 2017 |

**Transparent photovoltaic and energy-harvesting glazing** · `🔵 pilot`

Coatings or interlayers that convert ultraviolet/infrared light (or edge-routed visible light) to electricity while remaining see-through, turning windows and facades into generators — physics limits output to roughly 5-50 W/m², so economics remain hard.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [⚠️ Ubiquitous Energy](https://solarbuy.com/solar-news/what-happened-to-ubiquitous-energy/) | startup | MIT-spinout leader in truly transparent UV/IR-harvesting coatings (UE Power) targeting residential windows with partner Andersen | Raised >$70M incl. Andersen strategic round; furloughed then terminated staff Apr 2024; website offline since Sep 2024 — effectively ceased operations · **☠ shut down** |
| [ClearVue Technologies](https://www.pv-magazine.com/2025/09/11/clearvue-unveils-gen3-solar-glass-with-66-higher-energy-output/) | scaleup | ASX-listed Australian firm whose glazing routes light to PV cells at panel edges, used in vision glass, skylights and solar greenhouses | Gen3 product >50 W/m² (+66%) unveiled Sep 2025; $3M non-dilutive facility for certification; ASX:CPV |
| [NEXT Energy Technologies](https://www.solarpowerworldonline.com/2025/02/next-energy-technologies-produces-5-ft-tall-transparent-solar-window/) | startup | Santa Barbara startup printing transparent organic-PV coatings that glass fabricators can laminate into standard IGUs | $13.4M Series C Feb 2024 (investors include fabricator Viracon); produced world's largest transparent OPV window (40x60 in) and installed six full-size units at HQ in 2025 |
| [Physee](https://www.physee.eu/) | startup | Dutch firm behind PowerWindow edge-PV glazing, since pivoted toward sensor-driven SmartSkin facade controls | EU pilot installations; current commercial traction of PV glazing unclear · *status unverified* |
| [Onyx Solar](https://www.onyxsolar.com/) | scaleup | Spanish maker of semi-transparent amorphous-silicon BIPV glass for facades, canopies and skylights — trading some transparency for real output | 500+ projects in 60+ countries incl. flagship US corporate campuses; profitable niche leader |

> **White space:** Physics caps fully transparent PV at tens of W/m², and Ubiquitous Energy's collapse despite Andersen's backing shows VC-scale economics don't close on vision glass alone; the viable openings are semi-transparent applications (spandrels, skylights, greenhouses, balustrades) where transparency can be traded for output, or licensing coatings into existing IGU lamination lines rather than building fabs.

**Automated exterior shading, screens and dynamic facades** · `🟢 mature`

Motorized exterior venetian blinds, fabric screens and louvers intercept solar gain before it passes through the glass — cutting heat gain through windows by up to ~90% — making them the cheapest peak-cooling fenestration measure; standard in Europe, rare in North America.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Warema](https://www.warema.com/en/external-venetian-blinds/) | incumbent | Europe's market leader in external venetian blinds and sun-shading control systems with full building-automation integration | Architects' Darling Gold award 2025; family-owned German leader with hundreds of millions of euros in revenue |
| [Griesser](https://www.griesser.ch/) | incumbent | Swiss maker of exterior lamella blinds and facade shading since 1882, dominant in the DACH spec market | 140+ years operating; core supplier for European low-energy buildings |
| [Renson](https://www.renson.eu/) | incumbent | Belgian specialist in tensioned fabric screens, structural louvers and ventilated facade systems | Major EU spec-market player exporting screen systems globally |
| [Somfy](https://www.somfy.com/) | incumbent | French maker of the motors, sensors and controls that power most of the world's automated blinds and shades | ~€1.5B annual revenue; de facto standard drive platform for shading OEMs |
| [Hunter Douglas](https://www.hunterdouglas.com/) | incumbent | World's largest blinds and shades maker, incl. insulating honeycomb shades (Duette) and PowerView automation | 3G Capital acquired 75% in Feb 2022 at ~$7.1B enterprise value; continues operating globally · **acquired** |
| [SolarGaps](https://kyivindependent.com/how-a-ukrainian-company-reimagined-solar-panels-for-a-bright-renewable-future/) | startup | Ukrainian startup making sun-tracking exterior venetian blinds with PV slats that shade while generating power | ~$1.5M raised plus €1M EU Horizon grant; thousands installed; Kyiv factory operating through wartime, demand boosted by grid attacks |

> **White space:** Crowded and mature in Europe but structurally absent from North American volume construction — no installer base, hurricane/wind-code friction, and aesthetics resistance; an opening exists for a US-focused, code-compliant integrated window+exterior-shade product or utility-program channel, as DOE attachment studies show exterior shading beats most glazing upgrades on cost per ton of cooling.

**Daylighting systems: tubular skylights and diffusing panels** · `🟢 mature`

Tubular daylighting devices and translucent diffusing panels pipe or spread natural light deep into buildings, displacing 20-60% of daytime electric lighting without the heat gain and leak risk of conventional skylights.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |

| [VELUX](https://www.velux.com/) | incumbent | World's largest roof-window and skylight maker, including Sun Tunnel tubular daylights and commercial modular skylights | ~€3B revenue Danish foundation-owned group |
| [Kalwall](https://www.kalwall.com/) | incumbent | New Hampshire family firm making translucent FRP sandwich panels for facades/skyroofs, with aerogel-filled options reaching U-0.05 while diffusing glare-free light | In continuous production since 1955; spec standard for museum/athletic daylighting |

| [Parans Solar Lighting](https://www.paranslight.com/) | startup | Swedish maker of sun-tracking collectors that pipe sunlight through fiber optics up to ~100m into windowless interiors | Niche player (~5 employees) operating since 2003; technology proven but volumes tiny |

**Transparent aerogel and super-insulating glazing inserts** · `🔵 pilot`

Monolithic transparent silica aerogel sheets (or translucent aerogel granule fills) placed between panes add wall-like R-value with almost no added weight or thickness, promising triple-pane performance in a double-pane form factor.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [AeroShield Materials](https://aeroshield.tech/post/aeroshield-materials-selected-for-14-5m-arpa-e-award/) | startup | MIT spinout producing optically clear monolithic aerogel sheets to slot inside standard double-pane IGUs and door glass | $14.5M ARPA-E SCALEUP award Jun 2024 plus $5M equity Jul 2024; 12,000 sq ft Waltham pilot plant opened 2024; commissioned one of the world's largest critical-point dryers Jan 2025; first door-glass units produced |
| [Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/) | incumbent | Makes Lumira translucent aerogel granules used as insulating fill in Kalwall, polycarbonate and channel-glass daylighting panels | Commercial for over a decade across daylighting panel partners |
| [Okalux (Glas Trösch)](https://www.okalux.de/) | incumbent | German specialty glazier whose OKAGEL aerogel-filled insulating glass delivers very low U-values with diffuse daylight | Long-standing specialty product line; part of Glas Trösch group since 2018 |

> **White space:** Only a handful of players because supercritical drying of clear, crack-free aerogel monoliths is slow and capex-heavy at window sizes — transparency-grade optics is much harder than industrial aerogel blankets; whoever industrializes continuous or ambient-pressure drying for clear monoliths unlocks triple-pane performance retrofittable into the existing double-pane manufacturing base.

### Retrofit Delivery, Electrification Platforms & Financing (Buildings)

**Panelized / prefabricated deep energy retrofit (Energiesprong model)** · `🟠 demonstration`

Factory-built insulated facade and roof panels — often with integrated windows, ventilation or HVAC pods — are scanned-to-fit and clipped onto existing buildings in days, cutting the cost and disruption of net-zero renovation enough to make whole-portfolio social-housing retrofits repeatable.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Energiesprong Foundation](https://energiesprong.org/breakthrough-for-serial-renovation-of-residential-buildings/) | incumbent | Dutch-born market-development organization that standardizes performance-guaranteed panelized net-zero retrofits and aggregates social-housing demand across NL/DE/FR/UK/US. | 10,000+ buildings retrofitted across Europe and North America with 70-80% energy reduction |
| [ecoworks](https://www.eu-startups.com/2026/03/e23-million-backs-ecoworks-in-rolling-out-germanys-largest-serial-building-renovation/) | scaleup | Berlin general contractor that digitally plans and robot-prefabricates facade elements plus rooftop PV to take apartment blocks to net zero in roughly 7-10 days of on-site work. | €40M Series A (2024) plus €23M (Mar 2026) to deliver Germany's largest cooperative serial renovation |
| [Renowate](https://energiesprong.org/breakthrough-for-serial-renovation-of-residential-buildings/) | startup | Joint venture of listed German landlord LEG Immobilien and builder Rhomberg industrializing serial refurbishment for housing portfolios in NRW and beyond. | JV backed by a major listed landlord; growing serial-renovation pipeline in Germany |
| [Factory Zero](https://factoryzero.nl/) | startup | Dutch manufacturer of integrated energy modules (heat pump, ventilation, PV electronics in one rooftop pod) and prefab roofs used in Energiesprong renovations. | Core component supplier in the Netherlands, the model's most industrialized market |
| [Q-Bot](https://www.q-bot.co/) | startup | UK robots crawl under suspended floors and spray-apply insulation, retrofitting hard-to-treat homes without ripping up floors. | Thousands of UK homes insulated via partners including utilities and councils; BBA-certified process |
| [Hydronic Shell Technologies](https://www.nyserda.ny.gov/All-Programs/Empire-Building-Challenge/Empire-Building-Challenge-Projects) | startup | Facade-integrated mechanical systems: overclad panels carry hydronic HVAC distribution so multifamily towers electrify without entering apartments. | NYSERDA-backed demonstrations including a Bronx overclad project and a Syracuse pilot |
| [Dextall](https://dextall.com/) | startup | NYC startup making software-designed prefabricated unitized wall panels for recladding and deep-retrofit projects as well as new builds. | Venture-backed; panels cut facade installation time dramatically on NYC multifamily projects |
| [Melius Homes](https://www.meliushomes.co.uk/) | startup | UK design-build contractor that delivered Britain's first Energiesprong-style whole-house retrofits for social landlords (Nottingham's Destination Zero). | Pioneer Energiesprong UK delivery partner since 2017 |

> **White space:** Outside Dutch/German social housing the field is nearly empty — the US has no at-scale panelized-retrofit vendor (NYSERDA's RetrofitNY struggled to get bids that pencil) because fragmented ownership, custom facades and cheap gas stretch paybacks; building-performance-standard fines (LL97/BERDO) plus scan-to-fab mass customization create the opening for a US serial-retrofit integrator.

One-stop platforms plan, finance and install heat pumps, heat-pump water heaters, panel upgrades and EV chargers — using remote assessment, instant quoting and incentive capture to compress a fragmented multi-contractor journey into a single offer, which is why they dominate heat-pump growth in Europe.

**HVAC contractor software: load calculation, design & sales enablement** · `🟡 scaling`

Software that lets HVAC contractors scan a home, run accurate Manual J/S/D load calculations and generate right-sized heat-pump designs and sales proposals on-site — the workflow choke point that determines whether a furnace replacement becomes an electrification job.

| [Conduit Tech](https://www.thomabravo.com/press-releases/servicetitan-to-empower-hvac-contractors-with-acquisition-of-conduit-tech) | startup | LiDAR phone scans produce floor plans, ACCA-approved load calcs and visual sales tools purpose-built for heat-pump conversions. | $2.35M seed led by Breakthrough Energy Ventures (2023); acquired by ServiceTitan (Oct 2025) · **acquired** |
| [ServiceTitan](https://www.thomabravo.com/press-releases/servicetitan-to-empower-hvac-contractors-with-acquisition-of-conduit-tech) | incumbent | Dominant field-service operating system for HVAC/plumbing/electrical contractors, now folding in load-calc (via Conduit) and AI sales tooling. | IPO Dec 2024 (NASDAQ: TTAN); acquired Conduit Tech 2025 |
| [Wrightsoft](https://www.wrightsoft.com/) | incumbent | Right-Suite Universal, the long-standing Manual J/D/S desktop standard for residential HVAC design, now part of building-products group MiTek. | De-facto incumbent design tool; acquired by MiTek (2021) · **acquired** |
| [CoolCalc](https://www.coolcalc.com/) | startup | Free web-based ACCA-approved Manual J load calculator widely used by contractors and DIY electrification programs. | Among the most-used free residential load-calc tools in the US |

> **White space:** The category leader was absorbed by ServiceTitan within two years of seed, signaling consolidation into field-service suites; a standalone wedge remains in automated heat-pump design-to-permit (room-by-room sizing, duct mods, electrical load calc, and rebate paperwork in one pass), which furnace-swap-oriented incumbents still don't serve.

**Heat-as-a-service & subscription comfort models** · `🟠 demonstration`

Customers pay a flat monthly fee, instalment or lease covering heat-pump hardware, installation and maintenance — shifting the €15-25k upfront barrier onto institutional balance sheets, the way third-party ownership unlocked rooftop solar.

**Retrofit financing: PACE, on-bill/tariffed, and green home-improvement lending** · `🟢 mature`

Specialized lenders move efficiency and electrification upgrades off the credit-card tier — property-assessed (PACE) liens repaid via taxes, tariffed on-bill repayment through the utility meter, and point-of-sale green home-improvement loans — because monthly-payment parity, not payback math, is what closes retrofit sales.

### Smart Controls, Demand Flexibility & Thermal Storage (Buildings)

**Smart thermostats and home energy management systems (HEMS)** · `🟢 mature`

Connected thermostats and whole-home energy platforms learn occupancy and price signals to trim and shift HVAC load (the largest controllable home load), forming the entry point for residential demand flexibility.

**Smart electrical panels and circuit-level control** · `🟡 scaling`

Replacing or augmenting the breaker panel with metered, switchable circuits lets homes shed and shift loads automatically, stretch battery backup, and electrify without service upgrades.

| [Lumin](https://new.abb.com/news/detail/122691/abb-expands-residential-energy-management-portfolio-in-north-america-with-lumin-acquisition) | startup | Retrofit responsive-load panel that adds circuit control beside the existing breaker box instead of replacing it. | Acquired by ABB (Jan 2025) after Sunnova partnership and ABB minority investment in 2023 · **acquired** |

**Meter collars and panel-upgrade-avoidance hardware** · `🟡 scaling`

Devices that tap power at the meter socket or share existing 240V circuits let homes add solar, batteries, EV charging and heat pumps without a costly panel/service upgrade — removing a key electrification bottleneck.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ConnectDER](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/connectder-secures-series-d-funding-to-accelerate-growth-and-deliver-transformational-resiliency-and-electrification-solutions-across-north-american-homes-302317928.html) | scaleup | The leading meter socket adapter (collar) for interconnecting solar/storage/EV charging at the meter; new IslandDER adds whole-home backup islanding. | $35M Series D (Dec 2024, Decarbonization Partners/BlackRock-Temasek); 25,000+ adapters deployed, approved in 20+ states |
| [Siemens](https://chargedevs.com/newswire/connectder-raises-35-million-to-scale-its-meter-socket-adapters-for-ev-charging/) | incumbent | Invested in and partnered with ConnectDER to commercialize a UL-certified meter-mounted EV charging adapter through its eMobility business. | Incumbent channel validation for the meter-collar form factor |
| [NeoCharge](https://getneocharge.com/products/neocharge-smart-splitter) | startup | UL-certified Smart Splitter that shares an existing 240V dryer/range outlet between an appliance and an EV with app-based scheduling. | $329 consumer product; utility rebate partnerships (e.g., SMUD $200 rebate); saves $1,500-$4,800 vs rewiring |
| [simpleSwitch](https://simpleswitch.io/) | startup | UL-certified EV energy management switch that load-shares a 240V circuit between a primary appliance and an EV charger or heat pump, no WiFi required. | Shipping products ($699 240EV); positioned around NEC load-calc workarounds |
| [Splitvolt](https://splitvolt.com/) | startup | Plug-and-play splitter switches (NEMA 10-30/14-50) for dual loads on one 240V circuit, cETLus certified. | Consumer retail traction in EV-charging accessories |

> **White space:** Sparse by design: meter-socket devices need utility-by-utility approval and UL certification, a multi-year moat that has left ConnectDER nearly alone in the collar form factor. With ~50M US homes on 100A service and panel upgrades costing $2,500-$10,000, low-cost meter-level interconnection and load management is a large, underserved opening as heat pump/EV adoption collides with service limits.

Continuous analytics on equipment and circuit data find faults, waste and savings opportunities that manual audits miss, turning energy data into persistent efficiency — though pure monitoring has struggled to capture value on its own.

| [Emporia](https://www.emporiaenergy.com/) | startup | Low-cost Vue circuit monitors, EV chargers and batteries forming a budget home energy management ecosystem. | High-volume consumer traction in energy monitoring and EVSE |
| [Copper Labs](https://www.copperlabs.com/) | startup | Wireless meter-edge devices that give utilities real-time, appliance-level insight from existing gas/water/electric meters without AMI upgrades. | Utility pilots/deployments across US; venture-backed |

> **White space:** Standalone monitoring keeps getting commoditized: consumer disaggregation is being absorbed into smart meters (Sense's pivot) and CRE analytics into BMS/FDD suites (Carbon Lighthouse's contraction). The open ground is analytics that closes the loop — automatically actuating controls or monetizing flexibility — rather than producing reports.

**Behind-the-meter thermal energy storage (ice and phase-change)** · `🟡 scaling`

Freezing water or melting phase-change materials off-peak stores cheap/clean energy as heat or cold, shifting HVAC and refrigeration — roughly half of building peak load — without batteries' cost, fire risk or degradation.

| Company | Type | What they do | Signal / status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Trane Technologies (CALMAC)](https://www.calmac.com/) | incumbent | CALMAC ice-storage tanks are the legacy standard for shifting commercial cooling to off-peak hours, integrated with Trane chillers. | Thousands of installations worldwide over 40+ years; mature niche product line |
| [Nostromo Energy](https://www.energy.gov/edf/articles/lpo-announces-conditional-commitment-nostromo-energy-enhance-grid-reliability-and-cut) | startup | IceBrick modular cell-based ice storage retrofittable to commercial chiller plants, operated as a dispatchable VPP asset. | $305.5M DOE LPO conditional loan commitment (Dec 2024) for up to 193 California buildings (~170 MW/450 MWh); first wholesale-market TES participation with Olivine (Nov 2025) |
| [⚠️ Ice Energy](https://www.greentechmedia.com/articles/read/thermal-storage-evangelist-ice-energy-files-for-bankruptcy) | startup | Ice Bear rooftop ice batteries for small commercial AC, sold via utility contracts (SCE). | Filed Chapter 7 in Dec 2019 despite 25.6 MW of SCE contracts; assets continued by Thule Energy Storage — the sector's defining failure · **☠ shut down** |
| [Sunamp](https://sunamp.com/extend/) | scaleup | Compact phase-change 'Thermino' heat batteries replacing hot-water cylinders, charging from off-peak tariffs, solar PV or heat pumps. | UK government-backed £9.25M EXTEND LDES demonstration; Midea heat-pump compatibility launch (Mar 2025) |
| [Phase Change Solutions](https://phasechange.com/) | startup | Plant-based BioPCM mats tuned to specific temperatures for passive load shifting in buildings, telecom shelters and cold chain. | Deployed across dozens of countries; partnership-driven model |
| [Viking Cold Solutions](https://www.vikingcold.com/) | startup | PCM thermal storage inside frozen-food warehouses that rides through peaks and cuts refrigeration energy up to 35%. | Installations across US, LatAm, Europe, Asia; claims LCOE below 2 cents/kWh |
| [Steffes](https://steffes.com/) | incumbent | Grid-interactive electric thermal storage (ETS) room and central furnaces that bank cheap off-peak electricity as heat, long used by co-ops. | Decades of utility-program deployments across northern US/Canada |
| [Axiom Cloud](https://www.axiomcloud.ai/) | startup | Software that turns existing supermarket refrigeration into a thermal battery for demand shifting and fault detection, no new hardware. | Deployed with major US grocers; venture-backed |
| [Harvest Thermal](https://www.harvest-thermal.com/) | startup | Smart pod that runs a CO2 heat pump to charge a hot-water tank off-peak, serving both space heating and hot water from stored heat. | Early-stage; California pilot deployments |

> **White space:** Thermal storage is cheap physics with hard economics: Ice Energy went Chapter 7 even holding utility contracts because project sales were slow and margins thin, and incumbents treat ice as a niche chiller accessory. The opening is financeable, VPP-grade TES with stacked revenues — exactly what Nostromo's DOE-backed, 193-building aggregation model and Axiom's software-only approach are testing — plus heat batteries riding heat-pump electrification in space-constrained homes.
